name: Covenant Eyes
product: Victory Shield (formerly Covenant Eyes) for Mac by Covenant Eyes

evidence.says: Covenant Eyes says Mac release 3.21.0 no longer requires Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon and records the app rename in 3.16.0.
The vendor provides the current macOS app through its signed-in download page and lists macOS 11 or later.

notes: The Mac app was renamed from Covenant Eyes to Victory Shield in version 3.16.0.

name: muCommander
product: muCommander dual-pane file manager by the muCommander project

evidence.says: The project identifies 1.6.2 as the current release, dates it May 14, 2026, and publishes a macOS arm64 disk image.
The project publishes the 1.6.2 release under the 1.6.2-1 tag.

notes: The macOS package has a 1.6.2-1 suffix while the app release is labeled 1.6.2.

name: PDFsam Basic
product: PDFsam Basic by Andrea Vacondio (torakiki)

evidence.says: The official download page identifies PDFsam Basic 6.0.11 and offers macOS ARM64 and Intel disk images and ZIP archives.
The maintainer marks v6.0.11 as the latest release, published November 19, 2026.
The release includes explicitly labeled macOS ARM64 disk image and ZIP assets.

name: Ovito
product: OVITO (Open Visualization Tool) by OVITO GmbH

evidence.says: OVITO's published download history dates version 3.17.2 to November 2, 2026 and provides macOS arm64 disk images for both Basic and Pro.

name: CZUR Scanner
product: CZUR Scanner desktop software by CZUR Tech Co., Ltd.

evidence.says: CZUR lists Scanner 5.5.5 for Apple Silicon Macs under ET Max and ET Ultra, dated October 16, 2026.
CZUR confirms the updated desktop scanning software runs natively on Apple Silicon without Rosetta.

limitation: The cited 5.5.5 download is for ET Max and ET Ultra, and other models may have different download versions.
notes: Use the desktop scanner download for the hardware model in question.

name: CircuitJS1
product: Falstad CircuitJS1 standalone circuit simulator by Paul Falstad and contributors

evidence.says: Falstad's official offline download directory lists macarm and macx86 disk images for CircuitJS1 5.0.6ts, with the ARM file timestamped November 22, 2026.

limitation: The directory shows a file timestamp and supplies no separate release date.
notes: This is the standalone macOS package of the circuit simulator.

name: UniverseStylize
product: Red Giant Universe Stylize plug-in component by Maxon

evidence.says: Maxon lists Stylize as a category of effects within its Universe tools.
Maxon distributes the Universe effects as plug-ins installed through a shared installer for use with supported hosts.

limitation: The documentation identifies the effects group and does not publish this component's bundle ID.
notes: The submitted identifier is an FxPlug component for the Universe Stylize effect group.

name: NetDrive
product: NetDrive for macOS by Bdrive Inc.

evidence.says: Bdrive lists macOS version 4.0.67 dated November 19, 2026 with distinct Apple Silicon and Intel downloads.

notes: NetDrive uses FSKit on Apple Silicon with macOS 26 or later. Bdrive keeps NetDrive 3 in version history.

name: QtScrcpy
product: QtScrcpy by Barry Ran, an Android mirroring and control client

evidence.says: The upstream repository tags v4.2.1 as its latest release.
The official release assets include separate arm64 and x64 macOS disk images dated September 24, 2026.

notes: The arm64 package uses Qt 6.5.3.

name: Artlantis
product: Abvent Artlantis 2021 architectural rendering desktop application

evidence.says: The Artlantis team confirms that distribution ended following the closure of Abvent R&D, which developed the product.
Artlantis distributor ArchiEspaña gives May 12, 2025 as the permanent distribution end date and says updates and technical support ended.

limitation: The vendor notice does not identify the final Artlantis 2021 Mac build or its architecture.
notes: Existing perpetual licences remain usable according to the Artlantis team. Artlantis RT² was a separate product affected by the same closure.

name: Avast Passwords
product: Avast Passwords for Mac, Avast's legacy standalone desktop password manager

evidence.says: Avast ended support for the old Passwords product across all platforms including Mac, gave the end of May 2025 as its data retention deadline, and directed users to the new browser extension or mobile app.

limitation: The FAQ does not identify the final Mac build or its executable architecture.
notes: The replacement is Avast Password Manager. Avast says local Mac data may still be accessible after May 2025.

name: Minitab
product: Minitab Statistical Software for Mac by Minitab

evidence.says: The vendor published macOS requirements for Minitab 19.2020.2, listing macOS Mojave through Big Sur without specifying CPU architecture.
Minitab says its desktop application is now Windows-only and macOS users have access to the web application.
Minitab says technical support is no longer available for version 19.

limitation: The final Mac build, its exact release date and architecture were not confirmed by the vendor pages.
notes: Version 19.2020.2 is the vendor-documented Mac build in the listing's release line. The separate web application remains available.

name: CPLEX Optimization Studio Community Edition 20.1
product: IBM ILOG CPLEX Optimization Studio Community Edition 20.1 macOS installer

evidence.says: IBM identifies 20.1.0 as the release number and lists a macOS installer distribution.
A user reproduces the installer log from cplex_studio2010-osx.app, which shows the InstallAnywhere runtime inside the exact application filename in the scan.

limitation: The installed CPLEX tools' architecture is outside the scope of the scanned installer bundle.
notes: The iainstall bundle was the installer wrapper for the product. A standalone listing for installed CPLEX would need the installed executable identity.

name: NoMAD
product: NoMAD 1.x, originally by Orchard & Grove/Trusource Labs and later maintained by Jamf

evidence.says: Jamf announced that it would archive the original NoMAD and stop active maintenance.
Jamf's release repository identifies 1.3.0 as the latest original NoMAD release and describes it as a universal build.

notes: The final version was universal and supported Apple Silicon natively. Jamf Connect and NoMAD 2 are separate products.

name: Logi Capture
product: Logitech Capture webcam recording and streaming app by Logitech

evidence.says: Logitech explicitly says Logitech Capture is Intel Mac-only and incompatible with Apple M1 Macs on Big Sur.
Logitech's March 2026 Mac compatibility matrix lists Capture as Intel-compatible and leaves the Apple Silicon column blank.

limitation: The vendor compatibility pages do not give a specific current macOS build number.
notes: Logi Tune and Logitech G HUB are separate products.

name: VK Messenger
product: VK Messenger desktop app by VK

evidence.says: VK's Mac download links to its own universal DMG.
Homebrew identifies the official Universal DMG as 6.0.57 build 41 and records preferences for the com.vk.messages bundle.
The vendor's versioned Universal DMG returns the same ETag and content length as the current official download.

limitation: The vendor CDN timestamps are modification dates and the release date was not confirmed.

name: Caprine
product: Caprine Facebook Messenger desktop app by Sindre Sorhus and contributors

evidence.says: The official repository identifies 2.61.0 as its latest release.
The official release list publishes separate Caprine 2.61.0 macOS arm64 ZIP and DMG assets dated January 2, 2026.
Homebrew identifies the same app and reports a Gatekeeper-related cask deprecation.

notes: The upstream download is available through GitHub. Homebrew flags the cask for Gatekeeper.

name: Table Tool
product: Table Tool CSV editor by Jakob Egger and Andreas Aigner (Egger Apps)

evidence.says: The developer lists 1.2.1 as the latest release, whose tabletool-1.2.1.zip I inspected to verify that Table Tool.app/Contents/MacOS/Table Tool is x86_64 only.
The Mac App Store still lists Jakob Egger’s version 1.2.1, released July 30, 2017.
The maintainer of the Homebrew cask identifies 1.2.1 as an Intel build and lists Rosetta 2 as a requirement.

limitation: Homebrew lists Rosetta 2 as required, and successful operation on Apple Silicon remains unverified.

name: Filr
product: OpenText Filr Desktop Client for macOS (formerly Novell and Micro Focus Filr)

evidence.says: OpenText identifies native ARM support in the Filr macOS desktop client shipped with the 26.2.1 update.
OpenText directs users to its marketplace for the Filr Desktop Client, including the Mac Apple silicon edition.
Novell’s Filr 3 documentation identifies the original Filr desktop application for Mac and Windows.

limitation: The exact macOS desktop client release date was not established.
notes: OpenText documents a separate Apple Silicon desktop download and distributes Filr updates to entitled customers.

name: Proxifier
product: Proxifier for Mac by Initex, currently published by VentoByte SL

evidence.says: The vendor offers Proxifier for Mac v3 and links to its official disk image.
The vendor changelog dates Mac version 3.15 to September 18, 2025.
Inspection of the official image's Proxifier.app Info.plist and Contents/MacOS/Proxifier identifies version 3.15.0 and a universal Mach-O with x86_64 and arm64 slices.

notes: Mac v3 uses com.initex.proxifier.v3.macos. The vendor documented v3 as the upgrade from Mac v2.

name: Cisco AnyConnect DART
product: Cisco AnyConnect Diagnostics and Reporting Tool (DART) module for macOS

evidence.says: Cisco documents DART as an AnyConnect diagnostic module that collects connection and installation logs for support.
A university installation guide shows the separate DART bundle installed alongside the actual Cisco AnyConnect client and uninstall utilities.

limitation: The scanned module's architecture was not verified.
notes: The version is from the scan. Cisco Secure Client is the product listing for the VPN client itself.

name: Uninstall AnyConnect
product: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client uninstaller for macOS

evidence.says: Cisco documents the macOS uninstaller bundled with AnyConnect.
A university deployment guide shows the uninstaller .app alongside the AnyConnect client and its auxiliary bundles.

limitation: The scanned uninstaller's architecture was not verified.
notes: The version is from the scan.

name: Uninstall AnyConnect DART
product: Cisco AnyConnect Diagnostics and Reporting Tool (DART) uninstaller for macOS

evidence.says: Cisco documents a separate procedure to uninstall the DART diagnostic module.
A university deployment guide shows the DART uninstaller .app next to the DART module and the AnyConnect client.

limitation: The scanned uninstaller's architecture was not verified.
notes: The version is from the scan.

name: Miro
product: Miro Desktop by RealtimeBoard, Inc. (Miro)

evidence.says: Miro links separate Mac downloads for Apple Silicon and Intel and names the com.electron.realtimeboard bundle in its troubleshooting documentation.
The official download page supplies the Apple Silicon Mac installer, whose Install-Miro.dmg I inspected to verify arm64 in Miro.app/Contents/MacOS/Miro and version 0.11.196 in its Info.plist.

limitation: The vendor does not give a release date for this desktop build.

name: Maxon Shadow
product: Shadow PC macOS cloud-computer client by Shadow, formerly Blade

evidence.says: The scanned com.electron.shadow Info.plist identifies the application as Shadow and gives Blade's copyright.
The vendor offers separate production macOS Intel and Apple Silicon downloads for Shadow PC.
The current Shadow cask maps installed preferences to com.electron.shadow and lists the vendor's versioned 9.9.10489 arm64 disk image.
The official versioned arm64 image returns the same ETag as the current production Apple Silicon link.

notes: Correct the public name and vendor links from Maxon Shadow to Shadow PC. The current Apple Silicon disk image exceeds the inspection size limit.

name: PDMan
product: PDMan v2 database modeling app by RoberGroup (liyue2008)

evidence.says: The original PDMan project URL now redirects to the PDMaas project.
The original PDMan release URL now redirects to the PDMaas release index.
The authors document the progression from PDMan v2 to CHINER and PDManer, and say PDMaas has since taken over the functionality.

limitation: The final PDMan v2 Mac release and its executable architecture were not established.
notes: The original project location and release index now redirect to PDMaas. The authors describe PDMan v2, CHINER v3 and PDManer v4 as successive generations.

name: jdNetdisk
product: 京东鲸盘 (JD Whale Disk), JD.com’s enterprise file-sharing client

evidence.says: JD’s live 京东鲸盘 web portal describes the file service and offers an enterprise ERP login.
The historical scan identifies the Mac bundle as edu.jdNetdisk.

limitation: JD’s public site requires an enterprise account and does not expose a current desktop release, installer or Mac architecture statement.

name: WacDonald's
product: WacDonald's Cooking Simulator by OneFish2Fish Studios, published by Alvin Tuo

evidence.says: The storefront mirror identifies the game as OneFish2Fish Studios' cooking simulator, credits Alvin Tuo, and points to former Mac App Store item 1528393418.
Apple's public lookup returned no matching current record for item 1528393418.

limitation: A current official Mac release and its architecture could not be verified. The original store listing was unavailable in the storefronts checked.
notes: The 2021 scanner submission is historical evidence only.

name: DiskO
product: Disk-O: Your Cloud Manager, Mail.ru's Mac App Store cloud-drive client

evidence.says: The vendor directs Mac users to install the app from the Mac App Store.
Apple's Russian storefront lookup returned no matching current record for the exact bundle ID.
Community inventory provides an Intel-only architecture result for version 2025.04.0024 of Mail.Ru.DiskO.as.

limitation: Current official distribution and release architecture could not be confirmed. Inventory of an Intel build does not establish that it is today's release or that it runs under Rosetta.
notes: The vendor's Mac App Store link led to an unavailable item in the storefronts checked.

name: Home Design 21
product: Punch! Home & Landscape Design 21 for Mac by Encore Software

evidence.says: The version 21 Mac manual lists Intel Core Duo or faster in its system requirements without specifying the executable's slices.
A user reports running the Mac edition of Home Design Studio 21 version 21.0.8 on an M1 MacBook Pro with macOS Ventura 13.4.
The vendor confirms native Apple Silicon and Intel support for the separately numbered version 22.

limitation: The exact v21 release's executable architectures, release date, and current availability were not verified.
notes: Version 21.0.8 is the build in the M1 runtime report. The vendor's native claim applies to version 22.

name: YubiKey Manager
product: YubiKey Manager GUI (ykman-qt) by Yubico

evidence.says: Yubico lists February 19, 2026 as the end of life for YubiKey Manager GUI and recommends Yubico Authenticator or the separately maintained CLI.
Yubico lists macOS GUI installer 1.2.5 dated February 3, 2023 and provides only Windows builds of 1.2.6.
Static inspection of YubiKey Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/ykman-gui in the official 1.2.5 package confirmed a single x86_64 slice and the com.yubico.ykman bundle ID.

limitation: The final macOS GUI build was Intel-only. Rosetta operation was not checked.
notes: The current CLI and Yubico Authenticator are separate products.

name: iShowU Instant
product: iShowU Instant screen recorder by shinywhitebox Ltd.

evidence.says: Shinywhitebox marks iShowU Instant end of life and says iShowU V6 replaced it on May 17, 2024.
Shinywhitebox's official update feed lists version 1.4.21 dated October 2, 2024.
Static inspection of iShowU Instant.app/Contents/MacOS/iShowU Instant in the official 1.4.21 disk image confirmed arm64 and x86_64 slices and the submitted bundle ID.

notes: The final legacy build is universal and remains downloadable. iShowU V6 is the replacement product.

name: Cn Neixin Pc
product: Daxiang (大象) enterprise messaging and collaboration client by Meituan

evidence.says: Meituan identifies Daxiang as its own internal communications app and describes its Electron-based Mac desktop client.
Meituan provides an official Daxiang download page that links to its desktop download interface.
The live vendor download interface offers an Apple-chip option and requires Meituan employee sign-in to resolve the current Mac download.
Meituan's publicly referenced fallback file is labeled darwin-arm64 and versioned 3.17.4.

limitation: The current macOS release version is behind employee sign-in and could not be confirmed.
notes: The Apple-chip option and historical 3.17.4 ARM package are evidence for native availability, but the historical fallback does not identify the current release. The Homebrew hints refer to different products.

name: Apogee Control 2
product: Apogee Control 2 audio interface control software by Apogee Electronics

evidence.says: Apogee lists macOS Control 2 software version 1.21.55 with support for Intel and Apple Silicon Macs, and identifies the Symphony Thunderbolt DEXT separately.
Apogee’s guide calls the Symphony package Control 2 Native and documents the Thunderbolt system extension without giving the control app’s executable architecture.

limitation: Apple Silicon compatibility is documented, but the Control 2 app executable architecture is unverified; the public ZIPs checked exceed 150 MB.
notes: Control 2 is packaged for several Apogee interfaces. The Symphony I/O Mk II Thunderbolt package uses a separate driver.

name: Transocks Mac Signed
product: Transocks (穿梭) direct-distribution Mac client by Chengdu Fobwifi Networks Technology

evidence.says: The developer’s Mac release notes name version 3.0.9.
Homebrew points at the versioned vendor Transocks_official_v3.0.9.dmg, which I inspected to verify that 穿梭Transocks.app/Contents/MacOS/穿梭Transocks is x86_64 only and matches com.transocks.mac.signed.
Homebrew identifies the packaged version as Intel-only and lists Rosetta 2 as a requirement.
Apple’s lookup identifies the separately versioned Mac App Store build as com.fobwifi.mac.

limitation: Homebrew requires Rosetta 2, and successful operation of this build and its VPN helper on Apple Silicon remains unverified.
notes: The vendor also distributes the Mac App Store variant com.fobwifi.mac under a separate version and bundle ID.

name: Toontrack Product Manager
product: Toontrack Product Manager by Toontrack Music AB

evidence.says: Static inspection of the current public Mac disk image Toontrack_Product_Manager_MAC.dmg found version 1.1.2 in its macOS 11 or higher package, with arm64, x86_64 and i386 slices in Toontrack Product Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/Toontrack Product Manager.
Toontrack separately announces Product Manager 1.1.8 through in-app auto-update.

limitation: Binary inspection covers the currently distributed public macOS installer build 1.1.2. The separate 1.1.8 auto-update binary and the 1.1.2 release date were not independently verified.
notes: The universal installer was obtained from the official Mac download button, which resolves to a signed download URL.

name: QVR Pro Client
product: QVR Pro Client for macOS by QNAP Systems

evidence.says: QNAP links QVRProClientMac-2.9.0.1770.dmg as its current macOS download.
QNAP’s release feed lists macOS 2.9.0 without giving the executable architecture.
QNAP documents QVR Pro Client performance measured on an Apple M1 and lists macOS 15 or later for the current client.

limitation: QNAP confirms operation on Apple Silicon but does not state whether the current package contains an arm64 executable. Its disk image exceeds 150 MB.

name: Shrew Soft VPN Client Connect
product: Shrew Soft VPN Client Connect (qikec) for Mac OS X by Shrew Soft

evidence.says: Shrew Soft’s release planning history records initial Intel Mac OS X support for the 2.2 generation.
The vendor now lists its VPN client downloads for Windows, Linux and BSD only.
The maintainer of a historical El Capitan setup reports removal of the macOS packaging from Homebrew and offers a copy of the old 2.2.1 package.
The historical scan records x86 for the net.shrew.vpn.qikec Mac bundle version 2.2.1.

limitation: A historical 2.2.1 build was x86. The final version of the Mac port and Apple Silicon runtime behavior were not established.

name: Slay Bells
product: Slay Bells horror game by Blake McKinnon Productions

evidence.says: The developer still offers the V1.1_MacOS ZIP, which I inspected to verify that v1.1 Mac_slayBells.app/Contents/MacOS/Slay Bells is x86_64 only and matches the scanned bundle identifier.
The developer announced the release of v1.1 on January 9, 2020.

limitation: Rosetta 2 runtime compatibility was not established.
notes: The Mac download is labeled v1.1. Its bundle records CFBundleShortVersionString 0.1.

name: Raven Desktop Beta
product: Raven Desktop Beta, likely the Raven scanner desktop client by Raven (Starex)

evidence.says: The scanned 0.27.11-beta.0 bundle identifies itself as Raven Desktop Beta, carries Raven copyright and reports x86.
Raven integration partner Neat reports that Raven Cloud support ended and that direct scanning into Neat stopped in August 2026.

limitation: The official Mac download could not be accessed, and the historical beta bundle could not be tied to a current build.
notes: The scanned beta was x86 at version 0.27.11-beta.0. The scanning partner’s service notice addresses Raven Cloud integration.
